status: Recommended lifecycle preserving approved founder/cash-only partner mechanics

clock.owner: original founder for life of company
clock.progress: monotonic founder board steps; never wall time or partner laps
clock.founder_full_exit: Clock remains original founder; no accelerated growth or reassignment.
clock.founder_finish: Settle to cutoff, stop future scheduled growth, retire all purchase/listing offers. Active partners may market-sell frozen current stakes.
clock.partner_finish: Settle to current founder progress; freeze own snapshot, mark lot nontradable and exclude owner from subsequent personal invoices. Other active lots may continue changing until founder cutoff.

listing.sold_units: absolute percentage of whole company, not percentage of remaining stake
listing.reservation: only committed paid transfer reserves shares

seller_settlement.linked_debt: mandatory proportional payoff of seller secured debt including posted accrued interest before net seller cash
seller_settlement.retired_rule: Oct2 gross sale credit/no payoff superseded by later approved central sale rules

incidents.value_shock: once to whole-company value; derive current owner stakes; no personal cash duplicate
incidents.cash_invoice: disabled unless authored payer and current owner allocation exist
incidents.asset_failure: value0; close company, cancel listings, stop growth; personal debt persists; no free rescue
incidents.after_founder_finish: Disable new company incidents. Settle or explicitly cancel pending company incidents before freeze; no silently skipped invoice.

integrity: ownership units sum10000 including simulated/system holders
retry same economic event no duplicate
finished player money and snapshot immutable
no partner may borrow purchase cash within same transaction

deferred_alternative.name: Bounded continuing Youth House rates
deferred_alternative.status: deferred recommendation NOT default; needs separate decision because approved continuing rates would change
